## Setup checklist
1. "Read Ledger" node: connect the SAME Google account + MAIN Spreadsheet used in the POS Ledger & CRM workflow.
2. Click **Activate** so this stays live.
3. Copy the Webhook URL from "Ledger Data Webhook" and paste it into `LEDGER_API_URL` in the Ledger Dashboard site (src/LedgerDashboard.jsx).

This workflow only READS data — it's safe to call as often as the dashboard needs.

const rows = $input.all().map(item => item.json);

const orders = rows.map(r => ({
  orderNumber: r.OrderNumber,
  day: r.Day,
  date: r.Date,
  time: r.Time,
  customer: r.Customer,
  items: r.Items,
  subtotal: Number(r.Subtotal) || 0,
  discount: Number(r.Discount) || 0,
  tax: Number(r.Tax) || 0,
  total: Number(r.Total) || 0,
  cost: Number(r.Cost) || 0,
  profit: Number(r.Profit) || 0,
  paymentMethod: r.PaymentMethod,
  orderType: r.OrderType,
  note: r.Note,
  month: (r.Date || '').slice(0, 7)
}));

return [{ json: { success: true, count: orders.length, orders } }];
